description: Defines an abstract class 'Task' implementing Runnable, providing a framework for long-running, cancellable tasks with lifecycle hooks and auto-restart capability.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: An abstract class for creating cancellable, long-running tasks with lifecycle hooks and optional auto-restart.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Returns whether the task is currently running.

methods.name: isCanceled
methods.description: Returns whether the task has been told to cancel.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the task in a new thread if not already running.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Sets the cancel flag and optionally waits for the thread to stop.

methods.name: shouldAutoRestart
methods.description: Checks if the task is set to auto-restart after completion.

methods.name: setAutoRestart
methods.description: Sets the auto-restart flag for the task.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution method, calls lifecycle hooks and manages task execution loop.

methods.name: keepLooping
methods.description: Determines whether the task should continue running.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Hook called at the beginning of task execution.

methods.name: onRestart
methods.description: Hook called before restarting the task if auto-restart is enabled.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Hook called at the end of task execution.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Hook called when the task is canceled.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to perform task-specific work.
